job.job_description:
Hiring for One of the topmost MNC!!




ROLE: GEN AI Engineer




Exp: 4 to 8 YRS




Location: Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, Bengaluru




Work mode: 5 Days work from office




Notice Period: 0-45 Days Only




Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and machine learning technologies. The ideal candidate should have experience with modern AI frameworks, cloud platforms, and MLOps practices to build scalable and production-ready AI solutions.




Roles & Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI applications using LLMs.
Build AI-powered chatbots, virtual assistants, and intelligent automation solutions.
Develop and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
Integrate LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and Mistral into enterprise applications.
Design and implement AI agents using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
Develop prompt engineering strategies to improve AI response quality and accuracy.
Fine-tune open-source language models when required.
Build vector database solutions using Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, or Milvus.
Implement semantic search and document intelligence solutions.
Integrate AI models with REST APIs, microservices, and enterprise systems.
Optimize model performance, latency, scalability, and operational costs.
Ensure AI applications follow responsible AI, privacy, security, and governance standards.
Evaluate emerging GenAI tools, models, and technologies for business use cases.
Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders.
Develop automated testing and monitoring for AI applications.
Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and deployment guides.
Support production deployments and troubleshoot AI application issues.

--
Thanks & Regards
Nikhil C
IT Staffing Analyst

Bangalore,Karnataka,India.
